violations.affected_code:
IconButton(
  icon: Icon(isFavorite ? Icons.favorite : Icons.favorite_border),
  onPressed: onPressed,
)
violations.explanation: The IconButton has no tooltip or semanticLabel, and the Icon has no semanticLabel. Material icons carry no inherent text, so screen readers announce only 'button' without describing its purpose (e.g., 'Add to favorites'/'Remove from favorites').

The favorite on/off state is conveyed only visually by swapping icons. No toggled/selected semantics (e.g., Semantics(toggled: isFavorite) or IconButton isSelected with selectedIcon) or state-dependent label is provided, so assistive technology users cannot determine whether the item is currently favorited.
